termsBody:
Staff Arts — Terms & Conditions

Last updated: May 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account and using Staff Arts, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

2. Use of the Service
Staff Arts is a marketplace for art, exhibitions, events, and music. You may browse without an account, but creating, buying, or selling artwork requires registration.

3. Your Account
You are responsible for keeping your PIN safe. You agree not to share your account credentials. Notify us immediately of unauthorized use.

4. Content
You retain ownership of content you upload. By uploading you grant Staff Arts a non-exclusive license to display, distribute, and promote your content on the platform.

5. Conduct
You agree not to:
• Upload content that infringes intellectual property rights
• Post unlawful, hateful, or harassing material
• Misrepresent the authenticity or provenance of artwork
• Use the platform to defraud other users

6. Sales and Payments
Sales are between buyer and seller. Staff Arts facilitates the connection but is not a party to the transaction.

7. Termination
We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from settings.

8. Privacy
Your data is handled according to our Privacy Policy, including the storage of your email and PIN hash for authentication.

9. Limitation of Liability
Staff Arts is provided "as is." Qup DA is not liable for indirect damages arising from your use of the service.

10. Changes
We may update these terms. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

11. Contact
For questions about these terms, email post@staffarts.com.

— Qup DA, Norway (org. 912 372 022)

aboutAppTagline: A home for art, artists, and collectors.
aboutAppWhat: Staff Arts is a marketplace and meeting place for original art. Discover artworks, follow artists, explore exhibitions and events, and connect directly with the people behind the work.
aboutAppStory: Staff Arts is named in tribute to “Staff” — a mixed-media artist whose work blends materials, textures, and feeling into something wholly her own. This app was built as a love letter to that spirit: a place where art made with heart can find the people who will treasure it.
